title: Argentinian Pork Knuckle
description: A slow-cooked pork knuckle dish inspired by Argentinian cuisine, ideal for a hearty meal.
instructions: Season the pork knuckle with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, mix together olive oil, chimichurri sauce, oregano, and minced garlic.
Rub the mixture all over the pork knuckle, ensuring it's evenly coated.
Place the pork knuckle in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast for 2 1/2 hours or until the meat is tender and easily shredded with a fork.
While the pork is cooking, sauté the aromatic onions in a pan with a bit of oil until they're soft and translucent.
Once the pork is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
Slice the pork into thick slabs and serve with the sautéed onions.
Serve with additional chimichurri sauce on the side, if desired.
